summary.shortDescription: Provisional research record for Tenpower INR21700-60XG.
summary.description: Tenpower identifies INR21700-60XG as a 6000mAh 21700 cell. Its specification distinguishes 40A without temperature cutoff from 60A with a 75C cutoff, and Battery Mooch tested the exact model in July 2026.
highlights: Exact model identity is supported by Tenpower data and an exact-model vaping test.
Discovery value is 6000mAh and 40A continuous; 60A is temperature-limited.
The model is newly available and its production/revision continuity should be rechecked.
Runtime admission is recorded as battery-88.
Runtime admission is recorded separately from editorial visibility.

claims.statement: The exact product identity is Tenpower INR21700-60XG.
Tenpower specifies 6000mAh nominal capacity for INR21700-60XG.
The manufacturer specification states 40A continuous without temperature cutoff and 60A with a 75C cutoff; the conservative discovery value is 40A.
The exact Tenpower INR21700-60XG has an eligible exact-model vaping battery test.
The current Steam Engine battery catalog contains no exact Tenpower INR21700-60XG preset.
